name: Hasshaku-sama
description: Hasshaku-sama is a Japanese internet-era urban legend originating on 2channel describing an unnaturally tall female ghost roughly 2.4 metres in height who, having become fixated on a child, pursues them with a deep masculine 'po, po, po' laugh and an ability to imitate family members' voices.
origin: Japanese internet folklore originating on 2channel; the canonical story is set in rural Japan but the legend itself is now globally circulated through creepypasta communities.
